description: This file defines a function `cost_calculator` that computes the cost of image generation using the CometAPI model. It imports necessary modules and types, retrieves model information, and calculates cost based on the number of images in an ImageResponse object.

classes.name: ImageResponse
classes.description: A type representing the response containing image data, imported from litellm.types.utils.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( model: str, image_response: Any, )
methods.description: Calculates the total cost for image generation based on the model and image response data.
